Count and proportion of cells per group and condition

Source: R/composition_plots.R
summarize_group_meta.Rd

Counts the cells of each group (e.g. cell type) in each condition, and the proportion they make up of that condition's cells, optionally within panels (`facet.by`) and per sample (`sample.by`). The data behind plot_composition_scatter.

Usage

summarize_group_meta(
  object,
  group.by,
  split.by,
  facet.by = NULL,
  sample.by = NULL,
  cells = NULL
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object, or a data frame with one row per cell (e.g. its metadata)

group.by

Column of the groups counted (e.g. cell type)

split.by

Column of the conditions (e.g. genotype)

facet.by

Column within whose levels proportions are computed separately (e.g. stage), or NULL (default)

sample.by

Column of the samples, to count each sample separately, or NULL (default) to pool cells

cells

Cells (rows) to use, as names or indices. If NULL (default), all

Value

A data frame with one row per group and condition (and facet and sample): `facet`, `sample` (when given), `condition`, `group`, `count`, `total` (cells of the condition) and `prop`. Groups with no cells in a condition are included with a count of 0. Cells without a value in any of the columns are left out, with a message

See also

plot_composition_scatter

Examples

meta <- data.frame(
    cell_type = c("A", "A", "B", "B", "B", "C"),
    genotype = c("WT", "Mut", "WT", "Mut", "Mut", "WT")
)
summarize_group_meta(meta, group.by = "cell_type", split.by = "genotype")
#>   condition group count total      prop
#> 1       Mut     A     1     3 0.3333333
#> 2       Mut     B     2     3 0.6666667
#> 3       Mut     C     0     3 0.0000000
#> 4        WT     A     1     3 0.3333333
#> 5        WT     B     1     3 0.3333333
#> 6        WT     C     1     3 0.3333333
